comment: Gate 0 template shortcut (template-match.js). A token whose source is not published yet is still accepted at Gate 0 if its runtime bytecode is IDENTICAL (Solidity metadata tail ignored) to the reference token's, and its pool is on the named hook. Each reference must be a token whose source is verified on the explorer. Turn the shortcut off with TEMPLATE_MATCH=0 in .env.
